title: Saturating sensor arithmetic
description: Implement int16_t saturating_add(int16_t a, int16_t b).
prompt:
Implement int16_t saturating_add(int16_t a, int16_t b).
Return the mathematical sum clamped to the signed 16-bit range.
constraints: Do not depend on signed overflow or implementation-defined narrowing.
INT16_MIN and INT16_MAX are valid inputs.

tests.name: Normal sum
Positive saturation
Negative saturation
Opposite extremes
Two minima

rubric: Respect the stated contract and bounds.
Explain integer widths, ownership, and relevant edge cases.
Separate host-test evidence from hardware guarantees.
follow_ups: Which boundary conditions would you test on the target?
What changes if the function is called from an ISR?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
